shadows.name: focus-ring-on-violet

components.name: Tag Chip (Quality)
components.description: Pill chip washed 14% toward its section color; deepens to 25% on hover. Requirement and approach variants swap the --chip-cat color.
components.css: .ds-chip-quality { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--brand-paper, #f8f7f2) 86%, var(--brand-blue, #00b8f5) 14%); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--brand-paper, #f8f7f2) 65%, var(--brand-blue, #00b8f5) 35%); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--brand-blue-text, #003366); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2; padding: 0.22rem 0.7rem; text-decoration: none; transition: background 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-chip-quality span { font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 400; opacity: 0.7; } .ds-chip-quality:hover, .ds-chip-quality:focus-visible { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--brand-paper, #f8f7f2) 75%, var(--brand-blue, #00b8f5) 25%); border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--brand-paper, #f8f7f2) 50%, var(--brand-blue, #00b8f5) 50%); } .ds-chip-quality:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--brand-violet, #682d63), 0 0 0 4px var(--brand-cream, #fbf6ef); }

components.name: Hero Chip
components.description: Quieter chip for the section-hero chips row — violet-alpha wash, ink text; section identity stays in the rail.
components.css: .ds-chip-hero { display: inline-block; background: rgba(104, 45, 99, 0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(104, 45, 99, 0.18); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--brand-ink, #241823); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; padding: 0.12rem 0.55rem; text-decoration: none; transition: background 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-chip-hero:hover, .ds-chip-hero:focus-visible { background: rgba(104, 45, 99, 0.12); border-color: rgba(104, 45, 99, 0.32); } .ds-chip-hero:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--brand-violet, #682d63), 0 0 0 4px var(--brand-cream, #fbf6ef); }

components.name: Section Hero
components.description: The signature container: paper card, 8–14% section wash, 10px colored left rail, eyebrow → serif title → muted lede → chips.
components.html:
Quality

Reliability

The ability of a system to perform its required functions under stated conditions for a specified period of time.
components.css: .ds-section-hero { position: relative; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--brand-paper, #f8f7f2) 86%, var(--brand-blue, #00b8f5) 14%); border: 1px solid rgba(104, 45, 99, 0.18); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.75rem 1.4rem 0.7rem 2rem; } .ds-section-hero::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0.55rem; bottom: 0.55rem; width: 10px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--brand-blue, #00b8f5); } .ds-section-hero-eyebrow { color: var(--brand-muted, #746671); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0 0 0.25rem; } .ds-section-hero-title { color: var(--brand-ink, #241823); font-family: 'Libre Caslon Text', Georgia, serif; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 2.4vw, 1.95rem); font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; line-height: 1.15; margin: 0 0 0.3rem; } .ds-section-hero-lede { color: var(--brand-muted, #746671); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.4; margin: 0; max-width: 78ch; }

components.name: Panel Divider
components.description: Mini-hero used between lists on tag pages: 6px rail, 20% wash, h2 only.
components.css: .ds-panel-divider { position: relative; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--brand-paper, #f8f7f2) 80%, var(--reqs-background-color, #ffb3b3) 20%); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--brand-paper, #f8f7f2) 65%, var(--reqs-background-color, #ffb3b3) 35%); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.9rem 1rem 0.9rem 1.7rem; } .ds-panel-divider::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0.5rem; bottom: 0.5rem; width: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--reqs-background-color, #ffb3b3); } .ds-panel-divider h2 { margin: 0; padding: 0; color: var(--brand-ink, #241823); font-family: 'Libre Caslon Text', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.15; }

components.name: Facet Pill
components.description: Filter pill from the standards explorer; active state fills with Standard Gold plus an inset keyline.
components.css: .ds-facet-pill { border: 1px solid #ead8ab; border-radius: 999px; background: #ffffff; color: #655c4a; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 0.23rem 0.56rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-facet-pill span { margin-left: 0.28rem; font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-facet-pill:hover { background: #fff6de; } .ds-facet-pill:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--brand-violet, #682d63), 0 0 0 4px var(--brand-cream, #fbf6ef); } .ds-facet-pill.is-active { background: var(--standard-background-color, #ffc95c); border-color: var(--standard-background-color, #ffc95c); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); color: #4a3a0a; }

components.css: .ds-nav-demo { display: flex; gap: 1.25rem; align-items: center; background: var(--brand-violet, #682d63); padding: 0.9rem 1.2rem; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-nav-link { color: rgba(251, 246, 239, 0.78); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; transition: color 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link.is-active { color: #fbf6ef; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: none; border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fbf6ef, 0 0 0 4px #52214f; color: #fbf6ef; }

narrative.overview:
quality.arc42.org is a reference atlas of software quality. The interactive force-directed graph is the map; the homepage rails are the legend; every content page is a labeled plate. Each of the four content types owns exactly one identity color — Quality Blue, Requirement Rose, Standard Gold, Approach Green — and that color travels with its type everywhere: as a graph node fill, as a hero rail, as a chip wash.

The system is a working document, not a showpiece. Surfaces are paper-flat; color arrives as thin washes and solid rails, never as saturated fills. Typography does the heavy lifting: a pre-trend English reference serif (Libre Caslon Text) announces, and a low-vision-optimized sans (Atkinson Hyperlegible Next) carries the dense body content that architects scan under time pressure. The register is product: design serves lookup, comprehension, and navigation.
keyCharacteristics: Semantic color: every hue means a content type; decoration-only color is prohibited
Paper-flat surfaces with color-mix washes (8–14%) and solid left rails as section identity
Serif/sans two-voice typography on a 1.333 modular scale, 17px body base
Light-only theme (color-scheme: light), WCAG 2.2 AA non-negotiable
Motion is micro and stateful: 120–250ms ease-out, full prefers-reduced-motion coverage
Professional density: dense, scannable, tabular-nums for data, no over-spacing

rules.name: The Legend Rule
rules.body: Every content type owns exactly one color, and that color must match everywhere the type appears — graph node, homepage rail, hero rail, chip. The homepage is the legend; never let a rail color contradict its destination.

rules.name: The Wash Rule
rules.body: Section color reaches a surface only as a color-mix wash into Paper — 8% for calm sections, 14% for dialed-up sections, 25% at chip hover — plus a solid rail. Full-saturation fills are reserved for graph nodes.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Libre Caslon Text speaks only in headings (and the search dropdown's group labels). Atkinson Hyperlegible Next speaks everything else — body, chips, buttons, navigation, data. Never a serif in a UI control; never a third face.

rules.name: The Tabular Data Rule
rules.body: Counts, thresholds, and quality-requirement figures always set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Overlay Rule
rules.body: A shadow means the element floats above the page: popover, sheet, tooltip. If it doesn't float, it doesn't cast. (Standards explorer cards are the sole sanctioned exception.)

dos: Do route every section color through The Wash Rule (8/14/25% color-mix into Paper) and The Rail Rule (solid rail, 10px hero / 6px panel).
Do hold WCAG 2.2 AA everywhere: body text ≥4.5:1, and use Quality Blue Accent Dark (#1f5f82) instead of lighter blues on tinted surfaces.
Do apply the two-tone focus rings (--focus-ring / --focus-ring-on-violet) whenever a native outline is suppressed.
Do ship a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce alternative for every animation.
Do stay on the scales: radii 4/8/10/14/999px, the 1.333 type scale, the named z-index tiers, tabular-nums for data.
Do keep micro-transitions at 120ms ease-out and reserve cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for larger moves.
donts: Don't look like "a generic SaaS landing page, a startup pitch deck, or an AI-generated dashboard". No hero-metric templates, no gradient text, no glassmorphism.
Don't feel like "a blog or a wiki". This is an atlas with an information architecture, not a stream of posts.
Don't reintroduce saturated-fill pills or full-color background panels — the exact pattern the 2026 chip/panel refactor removed.
Don't use section colors decoratively. A color that doesn't identify its content type is wrong.
Don't add dark mode. color-scheme: light is doctrine; the light theme is the brand.
Don't set Libre Caslon in UI labels, buttons, chips, or data.
Don't add shadows to resting page-flow elements, extend the legacy hard-offset callout shadows, or invent z-index values outside the named tiers.
Don't add new ad-hoc muted grays — use Muted (#746671) or Text Gray (#383838).
